title: Material common module membership and input aliases
summary: Material common module membership and input aliases

facts.claim: FormlyMaterialModule imports the form-field, input, textarea, radio, checkbox, multicheckbox and select modules. It does not import datepicker, slider, toggle or native-select modules.
facts.context: FormlyMaterialModule umbrella common controls secondary imports registration
limits: Aggregate membership does not establish complete application setup or all Material entry-point registrations.
facts.source_quote: `FormlyMaterialModule` imports the form-field integration and input, textarea, radio, checkbox, multicheckbox, and select modules. It does **not** include every Material entry point. Datepicker and slider have separate modules; do not infer their registration from the umbrella module. [K13](sources.md#k13), [K18](sources.md#k18), [K33](sources.md#k33)

facts.claim: FormlyMatInputModule registers input with FormlyFieldInput and the form-field wrapper. It registers string extending input, and number and integer extending input with defaultOptions.props.type set to number.
facts.context: input string number integer aliases registration numeric type defaults
limits: The integer alias setting the HTML input kind to number is not evidence of integer-only validation, rounding, parsing or coercion guarantees.
facts.source_quote: Use the consuming application's v6 module setup, including reactive forms and Formly configuration. Do not introduce a newer-major provider API from an unversioned example. The input module registers `input` and aliases including `string`, `number`, and `integer`; the latter numeric aliases supply input defaults. Custom application names still require registration. [K03](sources.md#k03), [K32](sources.md#k32)
